# Vocabulary: agent_count_order

Order of magnitude of individually simulated agents in typical play. Aggregate populations shown as a number but simulated as stocks count as `aggregate`.

| id | label | definition |
|---|---|---|
| `none` | None | No autonomous agents. |
| `aggregate` | Aggregate only | Populations are numbers, not individuals. |
| `1` | ~1 | One autonomous agent (a pet, a creature). |
| `10` | ~10 | Around ten individually simulated agents. |
| `100` | ~100 | Tens to hundreds. |
| `1k` | ~1,000 | Hundreds to a few thousand. |
| `10k-plus` | 10,000+ | Ten thousand or more individually simulated agents. |
